evidence: Sort by Priority yields: High (Review project proposal), High (Complete tax filing), High (Submit final report), Medium (Schedule dentist appointment), Low (Buy groceries) — High > Medium > Low ordering respected.
With empty title the "Create Task" button is disabled; typing whitespace-only "   " keeps it disabled (button.disabled === true), so no task can be created and the list stays at 5 active.
Created "QA Alpha Task" with a non-empty title; it appears in the active list and the count went from "5 active" to "6 active" (Active tab badge 5→6).

Create form accepted title, description, deadline (2026-09-20), priority High and prerequisite "Buy groceries". Created card shows: QA Alpha Task | High | Alpha description for QA. | Sep 20 | Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete.

Sort by Deadline: Buy groceries (Aug 29/Tomorrow), Review project proposal (Aug 30), Submit final report (Sep 2), Schedule dentist (Sep 4), Complete tax filing (Sep 11), QA Alpha Task (Sep 20), then QA NoDeadline Task (no deadline) last.

issue: Blocked task cannot be edited at all — description and priority are not modifiable
actual: On blocked task "Complete tax filing" (prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete) the edit button is fully disabled (button.disabled === true) and no alternative edit affordance exists: single-click and double-click on the card/title open no dialog (document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]') is empty). Therefore the required partial edit (description + priority editable, title + deadline locked) is impossible.

evidence: Blocked card "Complete tax filing" carries distinguishing classes "bg-muted/30 border-dashed border-warning/40" plus a warning row, and its complete toggle is disabled (button.disabled === true), unlike unblocked cards whose toggle is enabled.

Single incomplete prerequisite: "Complete tax filing" shows warning 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete' (names it). Multiple: "Submit final report" shows "2 prerequisites incomplete" (reports the count).

Hovering 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete' shows tooltip "Dependency Chain / Review project proposal — pending". Hovering "2 prerequisites incomplete" shows "Dependency Chain / Review project proposal — pending / Complete tax filing — pending", identifying each pending prerequisite.

Dashed SVG connectors (stroke-dasharray "6,4") with a transparent 16px hit path act as tooltip triggers. Pointer-hover on the connector between "Submit final report" and its prerequisites set data-state="delayed-open" and rendered tooltip: "Dependency Chain — Submit final report: pending, Review project proposal: pending, Complete tax filing: pending" (chain + completion state).

Tabs show "Active 7" / "Completed 2". Active view lists only the 7 incomplete tasks; clicking Completed shows only "Reply to client emails" and "Organize desk" (the 2 completed), matching the badge counts.

Every card shows title + priority badge. Description/deadline appear only when supplied ("QA NoDeadline Task | Medium" has neither; "Buy groceries | Low | Milk, eggs... | Tomorrow" has both). Blocked cards expose warning rows ('Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete', "2 prerequisites incomplete"). Completed cards are visibly distinguished: title class "line-through text-muted-foreground", card class "bg-muted/50".

Clicked the completion toggle on active unblocked task "Review project proposal": header changed "7 active, 2 completed" → "6 active, 3 completed", tabs Active 7→6 / Completed 2→3, and the task disappeared from the active list.

Before: "Complete tax filing" toggle disabled with warning 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'. After completing that prerequisite the card shows "1 prerequisite completed" and its toggle is enabled (disabled === false). "Submit final report" still has an incomplete prereq and remains disabled.

After completing "Review project proposal" it is still present in the Completed view (3 items: Reply to client emails, Review project proposal, Organize desk) with its data intact and an enabled reopen toggle plus edit/delete buttons — completion did not delete it.

Prerequisite pickers omit any cycle-creating task. Editing "Complete tax filing" (dependents: Submit final report, QA Edited Task) offers only QA Alpha Task, Review project proposal, Schedule dentist, Buy groceries, Organize desk, Reply to client emails — self and both direct dependents excluded. Editing "Review project proposal" additionally excludes indirect dependents 2 hops away (Submit final report, QA Edited Task via Complete tax filing), leaving only 5 safe options.

Assigned two prerequisites (Schedule dentist appointment + Complete tax filing) to "QA Edited Task" via edit; saved card displays "2 prerequisites incomplete" and is rendered blocked. Single-prerequisite assignment also retained: "Complete tax filing" reopened in edit shows "Review project proposal" checked.

Edited unblocked task "QA NoDeadline Task": title→"QA Edited Task", description→"Edited description.", deadline→Sep 5, priority Medium→Low, prerequisites→{Schedule dentist, Complete tax filing}; all retained after Save Changes (card: "QA Edited Task | Low | Edited description. | Sep 5 | 2 prerequisites incomplete"). Deleting "QA Alpha Task" removed it from the list and dropped the count 6 active→5 active.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves the dependent task simultaneously completed and blocked (invalid state)
actual: "Complete tax filing" (completed, prerequisite "Review project proposal" completed) stayed completed after reopening "Review project proposal". The reopen was allowed with no warning/toast, and no dependent was reverted: counts went to "5 active, 3 completed" and "Complete tax filing" still sits in the Completed view, styled completed (title class "line-through text-muted-foreground", card "bg-muted/50", toggle "bg-primary border-primary") while simultaneously rendering the blocked warning 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'.
